---
# Education Section Module
---

```{r}
#| label: education-data-prep
#| include: false

# Process education data - collect detail columns if they exist
edu_data <- education %>%
  filter(highlight == TRUE) %>%
  arrange(display_order) %>%
  mutate(
    years = paste0(start_year, "--", end_year),
    location = paste(location_city, location_state, sep = ", ")
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    details = list({
      # Collect any detail columns that exist
      detail_cols <- c()
      if ("detail_1" %in% names(education)) detail_cols <- c(detail_cols, detail_1)
      if ("detail_2" %in% names(education)) detail_cols <- c(detail_cols, detail_2)
      if ("detail_3" %in% names(education)) detail_cols <- c(detail_cols, detail_3)
      if ("detail_4" %in% names(education)) detail_cols <- c(detail_cols, detail_4)
      # Also check for a simple "detail" column
      if ("detail" %in% names(education)) detail_cols <- c(detail_cols, detail)
      # Remove NAs and empty strings
      detail_cols[!is.na(detail_cols) & detail_cols != ""]
    })
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Process certifications data
certs <- certifications %>%
  filter(highlight == TRUE) %>%
  arrange(desc(year)) %>%
  mutate(
    abbr = gsub("\\s*\\(.*\\)", "", accomplishment),
    full = accomplishment,
    org = cert_body,
    desc = if("detail" %in% names(certifications)) detail else ""
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: education-html
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr is_html

for (i in 1:nrow(edu_data)) {
  details_html <- ""
  if (length(edu_data$details[[i]]) > 0) {
    details_html <- '<ul class="education-details">\n'
    for (detail in edu_data$details[[i]]) {
      details_html <- paste0(details_html, '<li>', detail, '</li>\n')
    }
    details_html <- paste0(details_html, '</ul>\n')
  }
  
  cat(paste0('
<div class="education-entry">
<div class="degree-header">
<span class="degree-name">', edu_data$degree[i], '</span>
<span class="years">', edu_data$years[i], '</span>
</div>
<div class="institution-name">', edu_data$institution[i], ', ', edu_data$location[i], '</div>
', details_html, '
</div>
'))
}

cat('\n---\n\n')
cat('\n## Professional Credentials\n\n')

cat('<div class="certifications-showcase">\n')
for (i in 1:nrow(certs)) {
  cat(paste0('
<div class="cert-card">
<div class="cert-abbr">', certs$abbr[i], '</div>
<div class="cert-full">', certs$full[i], '</div>
<div class="cert-org">', certs$org[i], ' • ', certs$year[i], '</div>
<div class="cert-desc">', certs$desc[i], '</div>
</div>
'))
}
cat('</div>\n\n')

cat('<div class="credential-note">
These professional credentials complement my academic expertise, ensuring I remain connected to industry practice and can design programs that prepare students for real-world success.
</div>\n')
```

```{r}
#| label: education-pdf
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr is_pdf

for (i in 1:nrow(edu_data)) {
  cat("\\textbf{", escape_latex(edu_data$degree[i]), "} (", edu_data$years[i], ")\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(escape_latex(edu_data$institution[i]), ", ", escape_latex(edu_data$location[i]), "\n\n", sep = "")
  
  if (length(edu_data$details[[i]]) > 0) {
    cat("\\begin{itemize}\n")
    for (detail in edu_data$details[[i]]) {
      cat("\\item ", escape_latex(detail), "\n", sep = "")
    }
    cat("\\end{itemize}\n\n")
  }
}

cat("\\subsection{Professional Credentials}\n\n")

for (i in 1:nrow(certs)) {
  cat("\\textbf{", escape_latex(certs$full[i]), "} -- ", certs$year[i], "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(escape_latex(certs$org[i]), "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("\\textit{", escape_latex(certs$desc[i]), "}\n\n", sep = "")
}
```
